Version 1.8 - 2026-08-16 - standard-first specification. All twelve APIs are specified against released SAP services or identified existing client routes. v1.7 (2026-08-12) is retained only as the comparison baseline; its ZCNF_* custom-service drafts are superseded.

v1.8 - 2026-08-16 - THIS IS A NEW SPECIFICATION, NOT AN ANNOTATED v1.7

ALL TWELVE sheets have been REWRITTEN as standard-first contracts. Each specifies the actual service or route, the operation/entity/action, request and response properties, the SAP field mapping, standard coverage, the v1.7 fields that do NOT exist in the standard contract, derivations, genuine gaps with named owners, activation status, required positive and negative tests, and a final disposition.

The speculative ZCNF_* custom services are gone. v1.7's envelope fields (RequestId, IsReplay, SourceSystem, MessageCode, TotalCount, HasMore) are no longer specified as SAP fields; each is listed on its sheet as a named gap with an owner - almost always CPI/T2.
API identifiers are unchanged from v1.7. Nothing has been renumbered. v1.7 remains the comparison baseline.
Classifications used: STANDARD-DIRECT / STANDARD + CPI-T2 ADAPTER / EXISTING CLIENT ROUTE / PROVEN CUSTOM GAP / RUNTIME-UNPROVEN.

Honest headline: API-05 and API-08 are the cleanest standard reads. API-01, API-02, API-09, API-11 and API-12 are standard with real adapter gaps. API-10 is conditional on $metadata. API-03 is a SIX-STAGE composition (stages A-F), NOT one SAP API. API-04 is a proven standard-OData DISCOVERY gap. API-06 and API-07 are existing DigiGST/EY routes that must be traced, not reinvented.
API-04, API-06 and API-07 returned ZERO candidate rows across the full 2,626-project SEGW catalogue screen. That absence is the evidence for their disposition, not a gap in the analysis.

Evidence: read-only SAP GUI trace of QS4 client 700, 2026-08-16, plus the SEGW design-time extracts of 14-15 Aug (SRC-SYS-20260814-01, SRC-SYS-20260815-01..16). OData entity types, properties and function-import signatures for the screened projects are LOCALLY EXTRACTED design-time evidence, not documentation. What remains unproven is RUNTIME: Gateway registration, activation, ICF, authorization and actual call behaviour. No OData call has been made and no service is activated.
System-validated: STO type ZP06; item category PSTYP=7; delivery type ZNL; plants 1002 -> 5412 and 1002 -> 1010, all in company code 1000 (intra-company).

Complete observed chain: STO PO 5600000339 -> delivery 0080019087 -> shipment 2100005093 -> goods movements 4900180168 / 5000014663 -> billing 1100012896 (ZSTO). GR proof: material document 5000018851/2024, movement 101.
SAMPLE SIZE - read every 'observed' claim with this caveat

Only ONE finding is population-scale: 22,378 ZP06 STO item rows for supplying plant 1002 (ME2W). Everything else rests on ONE OR TWO documents - EKPO-BANFN empty, LIKP-LFART=ZNL, LIKP-VSART on the delivery, the P+plant ship-to convention, the ZSTO billing type, the 101 goods-receipt reference model. Each is a real system observation and none is a population proof. Where a single-document finding is load-bearing, the sheet says so and the item is left OPEN rather than settled.
EXPLICIT BLOCKERS - these prevent implementation, not just certification

API-02 creation path is UNDEFINED - VL10X (2026 documents) versus custom ZLE020 (2024); neither is VL01N. Owner: Functional/business + ABAP/SAP.

API-10 AUBEL -> SalesDocument is UNVERIFIED. VBRP-AUBEL holds a PURCHASE order, but the released model names that property SalesDocument. Load-bearing for the STO-invoice join and must be proven against local $metadata before use. Owner: ABAP/SAP.

API-09 STO discriminator: DeliveryDocumentType = ZNL leads, category V supports. ZNL population validation remains OPEN, and delta is exposed at DATE grain only against a feed described as real-time. Owner: Functional/business + CPI/T2.
THE SHARED OUTBOUND SPINE - read this first

Trade, Non-trade and STO are three equally important business pillars. They share one outbound spine: a sales order (Trade, Non-trade) or a stock transport order (STO) leads to Create DI, then stock and batch selection, then shipment and freight, then goods issue, then billing, then the statutory documents.

API-02, API-03, API-04, API-05, API-06, API-07 and API-12 sit on that shared spine and serve all three pillars. API-08, API-09, API-10 and API-11 are STO-specific. API-01 is the inbound side - receiving stock into a depot - and is not one of the three outbound pillars.

SCOPE CORRECTION: earlier drafts of v1.8 read as though STO were the default architecture. It is not. STO is simply the first pillar traced end to end in QS4, because it was the flow available there. Every ZP06, ZNL, ZSTO and individual document number in this workbook is stock transfer evidence and must never be copied onto Trade or Non-trade.

Three words are used throughout for pillar behaviour. CONFIRMED means we know it. STO-OBSERVED means we saw it on a stock transfer document and it may not hold for Trade or Non-trade. OPEN means nobody has checked. An OPEN cell is not a small cell - it means unknown, not simple.
Never copy an STO-OBSERVED value into an OPEN cell. ZP06, ZNL, ZSTO, ZSTON, 641 and every document number in this workbook are stock transfer values.
COLUMN CONVENTION - read this before reading any request or response table

The Mandatory column answers ONE question: is this field required on the call? Permitted values are Yes / No / Conditional / Derived / Defaulted / Assertion only / OPEN. It NEVER carries an evidence status.

Runtime status is UNIFORM across all twelve APIs - nothing is runtime-proven anywhere - and is stated once per sheet in section 11. It is deliberately NOT repeated per row, because putting it on some rows and not others would falsely imply the other rows had been proven live.
HOW TO DEFEND A SINGLE FIELD - the five evidence levels
Every request or response property in this workbook carries FIVE separable claims. They have different evidence and must not be collapsed into one word.
LEVEL 1 - the property EXISTS: name, EDM type, precision, scale, max length. PROVEN from the local SEGW design-time extracts.
LEVEL 2 - the DDIC FIELD behind it. PROVEN - the extracts carry an ABAP_FIELD column per property.

LEVEL 3 - its ROLE: IS_KEY, CREATABLE, UPDATABLE, NULLABLE, FILTERABLE, SORTABLE, UNIT_PROPERTY. PARTIAL - see the mining-pass result below. IS_KEY is captured everywhere; the creatable/updatable/filterable/sortable flags are captured ONLY for the delivery family. A BLANK flag means NOT CAPTURED, never false.
LEVEL 4 - the BUSINESS VALUE is correct (ZP06, ZNL, movement 101, ZSTO). PROVEN by read-only QS4 table observation, subject to the sample-size caveat above.
LEVEL 5 - SAP ACCEPTS IT IN A LIVE CALL. NOT PROVEN for any API. This requires Gateway activation.

Wherever this workbook says RUNTIME-UNPROVEN it means LEVEL 5 ONLY. Levels 1 to 4 are evidenced. Earlier drafts of this workbook wrongly implied that property names were vendor documentation - they are local extracts from QS4 client 700.

The 14 Aug sequence is DI -> shipment -> shipment cost -> COST RELEASE -> PGI -> invoice (SRC-MTG-20260814-01 @12:28, @15:04). PGI must precede billing: without PGI there is no invoice (@14:11). Whether cost release is a hard SAP precondition for PGI or a business rule is NOT established.
ProcessId, stage status, resume and partial-completion semantics have no SAP home.

If stage D fails after stage C committed, SAP will not roll back the PGI. The client's existing ZMM_SCRUM_SER_PO orchestration has exactly this defect and commits its final stage without checking the previous result (D-030). Do NOT specify an ABAP call that pretends the chain is atomic.
Shipment and shipment-cost creation path unidentified.
SD_CUSTOMER_INVOICES_CREATE is application-internal. If architecture rejects it, validate the OData V4 billing successor or BAPI_BILLINGDOC_CREATEMULTIPLE and expose only the narrow missing command.

Existing and live, but the callable boundary is untraced.
Pick and batch-split one approved DEV delivery; PostGoodsIssue; create billing from the resulting delivery; read the billing document and its accounting document back.

Ineligible or insufficient batch rejected at PGI; billing attempted on an already-billed delivery must not create a duplicate; stale ETag rejected; stage-D failure after stage-C success must be observable as PARTIAL, not silently reported as success.
STO-OBSERVED - the receiving plant, as a customer

CONFIRMED means we know it. STO-OBSERVED means we saw it on a stock transfer document and it may not hold for the other two. OPEN means nobody has checked. Do not copy an STO-OBSERVED value into an OPEN cell.
Six-stage composition, A to F. STANDARD + CPI/T2 ADAPTER for stages A, C and E. EXISTING CLIENT ROUTE for stage F. PROVEN STANDARD-ODATA DISCOVERY GAP for stage B. RUNTIME-UNPROVEN throughout.
CONDITIONAL COMPOSITION across six stages (A-F). Not one SAP API and must never be specified as one.
